messages:
zoe: quick check  new 'first-run spotlight' banner that surfaces three starter templates. uploaded compact variant in Figma (link). main ask: ensure its keyboard friendly and the CTA copy is explicit.

pete: looks great. tiny concern: on 1024px width the banner overlaps the header nav when sticky. can we add top padding when visible?

maya: accessibility note: each template tile should have aria-label like "Open sample: Chat Assistant" and a visually-hidden description with estimated time. also ensure tab order focuses the tile as a single unit.

zoe: will add aria-labels and estimated-time text. for keyboard we want Enter to open the sample and Space to toggle the kebab menu for secondary actions.

maria: copy: prefer primary CTA text "Open sample project" instead of generic "Get started". add secondary text under title: "Preconfigured demo with one-click quickstart".

a11y-bot: lint: contrast issue in dark mode for helper text; recommended token --muted-3. also flag: ensure focus-visible is not removed.

pete: implementation note: we'll clamp banner height to 140px on small screens and enable internal scrolling for long descriptions. avoids footer overlap. opening ENG-4921.

maya: microcopy tweak for toast after creation: "Sample project ready  Open quickstart guide". keeps next action visible.

zoe: thanks  i'll update Figma and lock copy by EOD. can people drop final microcopy in-thread?

maria: dropped small change in doc: use em dash in toast. done.

pete: PR coming ENG-4921, will ping when ready for paired QA. :rocket:
